import os,stat,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
assert root.is_dir() and root.stat().st_uid==0
sha=(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
print('CURRENT_SHA',sha,'UID',os.geteuid(),'RUNTIME_MAIN', (root/'main.py').exists())
state=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
if state.is_file() and not state.is_symlink():
 st=state.stat();assert st.st_uid==os.geteuid() and not stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode)&0o077
 data=json.loads(state.read_text())
 print('STATE_KEYS',sorted(data.keys()))
 for key in ('approved_user_ids_done','approved_users_done','pending_member_ids','pending_member_actions','approved_join_requests_done','pending_join_requests','joined_groups'):
  val=data.get(key)
  print('LEDGER_COUNT',key,len(val) if isinstance(val,dict) else 'INVALID')
 for n in ('1','2'):
  a=data.get('accounts',{}).get(n,{})
  print('ACCOUNT_COUNTS',n, 'member_adds_today',a.get('member_adds'),'approvals_today',a.get('join_request_approvals'),'blocked',a.get('blocked'))
print('POTENTIAL_PROJECT_BACKUPS')
for base in [root,root.parent,Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads')]:
 for p in sorted(base.iterdir()):
  nm=p.name.lower()
  if base==root.parent and not any(s in nm for s in ('telegram','leads')):continue
  if base==root and not any(s in nm for s in ('backup','previous','legacy','source','archive','history','data','state')):continue
  if base==Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads') and not (p.is_dir() or any(s in nm for s in ('backup','histor','old','state'))):continue
  typ='SYMLINK' if p.is_symlink() else 'DIR' if p.is_dir() else 'FILE'
  print('PROJECT_ARTIFACT',str(p.relative_to(base)),typ,'in',str(base))
  if p.is_dir() and 'git' in p.name.lower():
   rev=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(p),'rev-parse','--short=12','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=5)
   if rev.returncode==0:print('GIT_SOURCE_SHA',p.name,rev.stdout.strip())
print('PROCESSES_PM2')
res=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],env={**os.environ,'PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2'},capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=15)
for proc in json.loads(res.stdout):
 env=proc.get('pm2_env',{})
 if proc.get('name') in ('telegram-robot-leads','iptvpn_bot'):
  print('PM2',proc.get('name'),env.get('status'),'restarts',env.get('restart_time'))
print('READONLY_PREFLIGHT_PASS')
